messages:
jin: Quick sync — Brightline POC: need to lock success criteria + integration plan. Customer expects a search+chat flow with reranking and streaming responses in 3 weeks. Can we scope evals, quotas, and retry behaviour?

claire: @jin yep. We should split success criteria into three buckets: quality, latency/throughput, and operational telemetry. Quick proposals:
• Quality: intent-match >= 85% on curated prompt set (200 samples), top-3 rerank accuracy >= 78%
• Latency: p95 generation < 300ms end-to-end for single-request streaming
• Throughput: sustain 50 rps with 4 concurrent connections during peak tests
• Cost: demo budget target < estimated $0.60 per 1k tokens (ballpark)

ashok: For integration notes:
• SDK: use official JS SDK streaming client, keeps token-level streaming + reconnect handling
• Auth: recommend API key for POC; customer asked about mTLS — we can enable for Private later
• Quotas: suggest soft limits: 60 rps / 10k tokens/min initially, can uplift during scale test
• Retries: exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries for idempotent ops. For streaming, use resume tokens.

ashok: example retry pattern to share with devs:
```
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY})
client.generate.stream({model: 'rw-search-v1', timeoutMs: 10000})
  .on('data', chunk => ...)
  .on('error', err => {
     // retry logic: exponential backoff
  })
```

mike: Customer asked about pricing impact if we increase throughput during the demo. Claire — can you give a realistic estimate to share (and any contract triggers)?

claire: I'll prepare a simple cost table. Also add these as acceptance checks for the POC:
- 200 eval prompts run through the PROMPT-SET repo with diffing on responses
- smoke test for streaming reconnection within 2s
- security: no logs containing PII persisted beyond 30 days; audit logs enabled

jin: Proposed timeline:
Day 0: kickoff + Qs answered
Day 2: send eval prompt set + integration checklist (SDK samples, env vars)
Day 5: first integration demo (streaming + rerank)
Day 12: scale test (load + quota uplift)
Day 18: review metrics + sign-off

jin: Acceptance criteria recap for Brightline:
- Intent-match >= 85% on curated evals
- p95 latency <= 300ms (streaming enabled)
- Error rate < 1% during scale test
- API usage within demo budget

mike: Sounds good. Any enterprise blockers (security questionnaire items) we need to escalate?

claire: Two items to flag to security team:
1) customer wants KMS-managed keys for private deploys
2) SOC2 appendix Q on data residency (they asked EUR-only storage)
I'll start the questionnaire and loop in security.

infra-bot: deployment/stage created: staging-pool-7 — capacity 4 gpus. Reminder: run canary with --dry-run flag

jin: Great — I'll send this plan to Brightline and schedule the 30-min kickoff. @claire please attach the eval set and cost table.

claire: On it :thumbsup:
